description: E11 (extension X1): Fig. 7a protocol training success vs qubit count n = 2..8 (reduced from 2..9 by the user on 2026-11-10 for run time), code and Haar training states.

plan.metrics: training squared loss logged at epoch 2000 and validation MSE on 500 Haar states, per model
plan.aggregation: median and min-max over seeds 0-4 per (n, state set, model); log10 loss vs n
plan.comparison_rule: paired by seed, quantum minus IM in log10 loss; with 5 pairs a two-sided Wilcoxon cannot reach p < 0.05 (minimum 0.0625), so only medians and the number of seeds favouring each model are reported, no significance claim
plan.scope_change: n = 9 dropped (user decision 2026-11-10: 'Stop at n = 8'); E10 measures gradient variance up to n = 11
